common.tagline: Tamil Nadu Job & Worker Welfare Platform

landing.title: HAM
landing.subtitle: Find work, manage jobs, and get support — in Tamil, English, or Hindi.

hero.headline: Work and support made clearer for Tamil Nadu.
hero.support: HAM helps workers find opportunities and employers connect with people — in Tamil, English, or Hindi.

roles.title: Start where you belong
roles.description: Pick the journey that matches you. You choose your role when you create an account.

worker.title: For workers
worker.body: Look for suitable jobs, keep your skills up to date, and track applications in one place.
worker.point1: Browse jobs after you sign in
worker.point2: Build a simple profile with your skills

employer.title: For employers
employer.body: Set up your organization, post roles, and review applicants with privacy in mind.
employer.point2: Review applicants without exposing private details
employer.point3: Manage your posted jobs in one place

benefits.title: Practical tools for work and support
benefits.description: These features are available in HAM today. Welfare scheme pages are marked honestly when not ready yet.

jobs.title: Job opportunities
jobs.body: Workers can discover openings that match their skills after signing in.

apply.title: Simple applications
apply.body: Apply in a few steps and track status without complicated forms.

profile.title: Skills and profile
profile.body: Share the work you can do so the right opportunities are easier to find.

employers.title: Employer connections
employers.body: Employers post roles and connect with workers through clear job listings.

legal.title: Legal support directory
legal.body: Browse approved legal support providers near you. Case filing is not available yet.

welfare.title: Worker welfare
welfare.body: Welfare scheme detail pages are not available from the API yet.

how.title: How HAM works
how.description: Three clear steps. No jargon — just what to do next.

one.title: Create your account
one.body: Register with your phone, verify with OTP, and set your role.

two.title: Complete your profile
two.body: Add your details and skills so matching jobs are easier to spot.

three.title: Apply and track
three.body: Apply to openings and follow progress from your applications list.

trust.title: A calmer way to look for work
trust.description: HAM is designed to be clear, private where it matters, and usable in the languages people actually speak.

privacy.title: Privacy-conscious screens
privacy.body: Sensitive personal details stay protected in employer and admin views.

clarity.title: Clear next steps
clarity.body: Actions stay direct — register, verify, apply — without clutter.

languages.title: Tamil, English, and Hindi
languages.body: Switch language anytime. The interface stays readable for more people.

finalCta.title: Ready to take the next step?
finalCta.body: Create your account now. Choose worker or employer during registration.

footer.note: Jobs and support for people in Tamil Nadu.
